evidence.detail: Each exact-v308 rs/l/e/d instance stores one accumulated numeric amount, a List<Integer> of contributing skill ids, screen offset/alpha state and one fade-phase flag.
The class is constructed and consumed only by rs/l/e/e, whose renderer maps the stored skill ids to the exact skills/<id> icon set and renders the accumulated amount with a leading '+'.
Rapid compatible updates merge their amount into the most recent entry and append previously absent skill ids, proving that the list represents skills contributing to one combined experience drop.

proposals.note: ExperienceDropEntry is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for one animated/combined skill experience drop. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The constructor loads exactly 23 13x13 sprites from skills/<id>, and every active drop renders the sprites indexed by that drop's stored skill-id list.
The update/render pass formats every drop as '+' plus its accumulated amount (using the client numeric formatter for larger values), then renders that amount alongside its skill icons.

The class owns active and queued ExperienceDropEntry lists, combines compatible updates arriving within 650 ms, waits for vertical spacing before promotion, animates/fades entries and removes expired drops.
The live Client skill-update path invokes rs/l/e/e.a(skillIndex, newValue-oldValue) only for a positive delta, directly tying this manager to per-skill experience gains.

proposals.note: ExperienceDropManager is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the complete 23-skill gain-drop queue/render lifecycle. Confidence is 0.999.
